sn35.58:1.1: kathannu kho bhante jānato kathaṃ passato anusayā pahīyantīti? cakkhuṃ kho bhikkhu, aniccato jānato passato anusayā pahīyanti. rūpe …pe…
sn35.58:1.2: cakkhuviññāṇaṃ …pe… cakkhusamphassaṃ …pe… yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi aniccato jānato passato anusayā pahīyantīti. evaṃ kho bhikkhu jānato evaṃ passato anusayā pahīyantīti.
